Title: Instructions for Accurately Documenting Failed Building Fire-Safety Checks

1. **Start with the Inspection Records**
   - **Date and Time:** Note the exact date and time of the inspection.
   - **Location:** Document the full address and any specific identifiers (e.g., floor, wing, room number) of the building/area inspected.
   - **Inspector Details:** Include the names and contact information of the fire safety inspector(s) involved.
   - **Checklist Utilized:** Attach copies of the completed fire-safety checklist with relevant comments.

2. **List the Failed Items**
   - **Item Number:** Reference each failed item from the checklist by its item number.
   - **Description:** Provide a detailed description of the failed item (e.g., blocked fire extinguisher, inoperable sprinkler head). Include any measurements, model numbers, or essential specifications where relevant.
